results.content: Second, disaggregated analysis in columns (2)–(6) shows that even with FDR corrections for all tests performed across practice categories and treatment arms, we find that the *All Three* intervention significantly stimulates the adoption of business practices on all dimensions of the handbook. Online Appendix Table D.7 presents quantile regression analysis for each decile of the business practice distribution and finds statistically significant effects in the *All Three* treatment group at every decile except the highest. While these measures do not directly indicate or confirm the use of specific business practices, they do provide a rough indication of whether the shop is better “organized.” As Online Appendix Table H.4 shows, we do see improvements on some of these measures in shop owners assigned to *Movie* and *Counseling*. On scalability, a back-of-the-envelope tabulation reveals the per-firm cost of the *Handbook* intervention was approximately US100, with the *Movie* and *Counseling* costing an additional US25 each.29 In contrast, the benefits were up to US310 per month in profits, along with a high adoption rate of efficient business practices.

results.title: Digital infrastructure and income disparities: A quasi ...
results.content: # Digital infrastructure and income disparities: A quasi-natural experiment based on the "Broadband China" strategy☆. Utilizing panel data at the national, provincial, and urban agglomeration levels in China from 2009 to 2021, it assesses the impact of digital infrastructure on income disparities. The empirical results demonstrate that digital infrastructure significantly contributes to the reduction of regional income disparities. Heterogeneity analysis further reveals that the digital infrastructure is more pronounced in eastern regions, larger cities, and areas characterized by higher levels of education and marketization. Our findings provide robust empirical evidence that digital infrastructure plays a significant role in promoting coordinated regional development, offering both theoretical insights and practical implications for advancing high-quality economic growth. :   We confirm that the manuscript has been read and approved by all named authors, and there are no other persons who satisfied the criteria for authorship but are not listed.
